name: Dust Plains
summary: Gnoll packs prowl the Dust Plains, Westfall’s dry southern frontier. The wastes stretch toward the coast and eastern hills, where Klaven’s Tower overlooks the plain.

sections.title: A Barren Frontier
sections.body:
Across southern Westfall, the Dust Plains lead from troubled farmland toward desolate wilderness. Feral gnolls have long claimed this dry ground. They ambush travelers and challenge anyone bound for the coast or nearby hills.

Klaven’s Tower marks the eastern boundary. Klaven Mortwake, a Defias rogue, holds the old mage tower. Gnolls prowl the surrounding wastes, leaving travelers no shelter there.

faq.q: Where are the Dust Plains located?
faq.answer: The Dust Plains lie in southern Westfall, south of the abandoned farmsteads. They stretch toward the cliffs and Klaven’s Tower to the east.

faq.q: What threats can travelers find in the Dust Plains?
faq.answer: Savage gnolls keep crude camps across the dusty plains. They attack anyone who wanders near.

faq.q: What is the tower on the eastern edge of the plains?
faq.answer: Klaven’s Tower is an old mage tower overlooking the eastern edge of the Dust Plains. The Defias rogue Klaven Mortwake holds it as a stronghold.

faq.q: Does the People's Militia hold any control over the Dust Plains?
faq.answer: No. The People’s Militia is stretched thin defending Sentinel Hill and the northern farms from the Defias Brotherhood. Prowling gnolls hold the Dust Plains beyond their reach.

angles.text: The Dust Plains are another lawless frontier where Stormwind’s neglect is plain. Travelers and local defenders face relentless gnoll packs without official reinforcement.
